state: Uncommitted implementation; not a published release

external_tests.inputs: Disposable copies of local flowtorch.DATASETS paths; original datasets not modified

contracts_checked: Cell centres, raw positive weights and fields match an equivalent reconstructed mesh
Single-open sequential chunks with no prefix rescanning
Unchanged geometry bytes and raw committed field chunks after append
Changed decomposition/mesh/schema/precision/filters and duplicate timestamps rejected read-only
Interrupted append hidden and retry succeeds
Previous processor geometry released before constructing next
limitations: Static nonempty single-region processorN meshes only; no collated output, moving meshes or boundary-field export
Geometry and temporary topology allocations remain eager per processor; total peak memory was not benchmarked
ASCII input memory also depends on longest line; chunk size is not a total memory limit
ParaView checks used manufactured geometry; no large production OpenFOAM case benchmark was run
environment_notes: ParaView/MPI and full test collection require local socket access in this environment
Independent ParaView checker avoids loading external h5py into ParaView bundled HDF5 runtime
